blocks.h2: When Your Gas Piping Needs a Plumber

tiles.h3: You Notice an Odor Near an Appliance
tiles.body: Furnace, water heater, range or dryer.
Repairs and a pressure test come before service is restored.
Abandoned pipe from old appliances should be capped and tested.
Uncoated brass connectors should be replaced.

bodies: When there's a suspected leak or the utility has shut off service, we find the source using electronic detectors and soap tests on the fittings, then pressure-test the system to confirm it's sealed.
In older Geneva homes, we often find leaks at old unions and valves, or on abandoned branches that were never capped properly. After the repair, the whole system is tested so service can be restored.

blocks.intro: Gas piping in Geneva ranges from very old to brand new.

items.body: The pipe lasts, but unions, valves and joints wear after many decades.
Lines that once fed old stoves, lights or heaters should be properly capped and tested.
Grills, fire pits and generators added later need lines sized and installed correctly.

blocks.h2: Gas Line Questions From Geneva Homeowners

items.q: What should I do if I smell gas?
items.preview: Leave and call Nicor Gas or 911 from outside.
items.answer: Leave right away and don't touch switches. Call Nicor Gas or 911 from outside, then call us for the repair.

items.q: Can you cap old gas lines in my historic home?
items.answer: Yes. We cap abandoned branches properly and pressure-test the system.

items.q: Who is responsible for gas piping?
items.preview: The utility up to the meter. You after it.
items.answer: Nicor Gas handles the line up to and including the meter. Piping after the meter is the homeowner's and should be repaired by a licensed plumber.

items.q: Do old gas connectors need replacing?
items.answer: Yes, if they're uncoated brass. Coated stainless connectors are much safer.

items.q: How much does gas line repair cost in Geneva?
items.preview: It depends on the leak and the line. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on where the leak is and how much pipe needs work. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
